agentSessionKey.title: Agent Session Key
agentSessionKey.description: Stable agent session key if available. Pass automatically from session context.

answerCapture.title: Answer Capture
answerCapture.description: Structured answer captured by the SmartIntake input renderer for the current question.

answersJson.title: Answers JSON
answersJson.description: Current accumulated answers JSON. Pass from previous action output.

answerValue.title: Answer Value
answerValue.description: Plain text fallback answer from the user when structured answer capture is unavailable.

intakeSessionId.title: Intake Session Id
intakeSessionId.description: Current SmartIntake session id. Pass from previous action output.

smartIntakeContextKey.title: SmartIntake Context Key
smartIntakeContextKey.description: Page, channel, or deployment context key used to resolve the SmartIntake template. Do not ask the user.
